verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile is a mobile client app for triaging, reviewing and managing GitHub work. Registrable outbound webhooks are a server-side platform capability, not something a phone client app would ship, so this axis is a category error for the product type. The evidence contains no mention of the app itself offering webhooks. GitHub platform features (REST API, Actions) are host-platform capabilities and do not change this, and the app's push notifications are not webhooks.
